checks.note: The agent-side writer enforces all six identity fields and the shared trace_id, and child() keeps trace_id for the extractor. Gateway, tool-service and worker audit writers are outside this repo.

checks.quote: GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON audit_events TO procurement_agent;
checks.note: The agent role has only SELECT and INSERT on audit_events, after a REVOKE ALL. Ops has SELECT only. Nothing in the app updates or deletes audit rows.

The role allowlist covers documents, ERP, payments, slack and memory tools. None of them touches audit_events, and the app only ever INSERTs into it. The ERP MCP server is an external system with its own store.

The vendor payment_id is stored in the tool_result audit row next to identity, trace_id and operation_id. However, the vendor calls send no trace or correlation header, and the ERP _meta carries only run_id and business_unit. The gateway's own mapping of verified identity and correlation ID to the vendor ID is outside this repo.

note: No check demonstrably fails in this repo: E10.2 and E10.3 hold, while E10.1 and E10.4 depend on gateway and vendor code outside it.
